messages:
emma: Heads-up — BigCorp asked to onboard next sprint with a 24/7 SLA and wants 'rapid onramp'. Can we accept a shorter benchmarking window if they sign a premium contract?
srinath: What does Sales mean by 'shorter'? Our minimum safety + perf bench is usually 72 hrs with 1k queries. We can trim, but need clear gates.
olivia: Sales says they can provide a curated sample corpus and are comfortable with a staged rollout. They want pinning to a stable model for 90 days and contractual rollback guarantees.
srinath: Operationally I'd propose: reduce bench to a targeted 500-sample customer corpus + 200 golden safety tests, but require a shadow run + staged canary. That keeps risk low.
nick: Need to call out infra: if they require 24/7 SLA we'll need reserved capacity (dedicated pool) or explicit burst guarantees. Otherwise we must state best-effort.
deploy-bot: canary slot available next Wed 09:00 UTC — book it with /canary reserve 1713054322-canary-slot
emma: Draft acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Bench: 500 customer-sample queries + 200 safety/assertion tests
- Perf: p95 <= 2x our baseline for that model family; p99 <= 3x baseline
- Quality/regression: automated eval drop <= 2% absolute on customer cohort; no critical safety flags above 0
- Compatibility: quantization/LLM adapter smoke (inference pass)
- Rollout: Shadow 48h -> Canary 5% 24h -> 20% 24h -> Full. Immediate rollback if error rate > 3% or quality drop > 3%
srinath: Add: KV-cache memory check and peak-seq-size perf run. Also require a compatibility check for customer's tie-ins (embedding schema, tokenization differences).
olivia: From commercial side: we can offer a premium onboarding fee for dedicated pool + 90-day pin. Customer wants contractual SLO language — can we standardize a clause?
nick: Ops: I'll produce capacity quote and impact matrix. If they want dedicated pool, give me target RPS and p50/p95 targets.
lin a (customer-ops): (Lina from BigCorp) We'll supply the 500-sample corpus by EOD Wednesday and can join the 48h shadow monitoring. Also ok with staged canary plan.
emma: Owners: srinath -> bench & compat plan; nick -> infra capacity & quote; olivia -> contract SLO wording + commercial terms.
emma: Timeline: bench plan due Fri EOD; capacity quote Thu EOD; contract draft Fri noon. Sync Fri 10:00 to finalize.
srinath: I'll post the minimal bench script + metrics we'll collect (latency hist, error-rate, eval-deltas).
olivia: I'll start contract language. Quick ask: can devex produce a short onboarding doc (one-pager) we can share with the customer during sign?
srinath: Yes — I'll include sample prompts and the eval harness.
nick: I'll add the cost delta for dedicated pool vs burst capacity in the quote.
emma: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll circulate the acceptance criteria to legal and field-ops. :thumbsup:
